description: Applies cell formatting to a range: background_color, text color/bold/italic/strikethrough/underline/font_size/font_family, horizontal/vertical alignment, wrap_strategy, and number format (number_format_type NUMBER/PERCENT/CURRENCY/DATE/TIME/DATE_TIME/SCIENTIFIC/TEXT with an optional number_format_pattern like "#,##0.00" or "dd.mm.yyyy"). Only the provided properties are touched — the update mask is computed automatically, so existing formatting outside it survives; at least one formatting field is required. The range is a grid rectangle addressed by sheet_id + 0-based indexes (get sheet_id from get_spreadsheet). Colors are "#RRGGBB" hex strings.

range.description: Cell rectangle in grid coordinates: rows 1-10 × columns A-B = {start_row_index:0, end_row_index:10, start_column_index:0, end_column_index:2}.

end_column_index.description: End column, exclusive (omit = to the last column).

end_row_index.description: End row, exclusive (omit = to the last row).

sheet_id.description: The numeric sheetId from get_spreadsheet (not the title).

start_row_index.description: First row, 0-based inclusive (omit = from the top).

spreadsheet_id.description: The spreadsheet id — the long id from the URL (docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/<spreadsheetId>/edit) or from create_spreadsheet / search_spreadsheets output.

wrap_strategy.description: How long text behaves: overflow into empty neighbors, clip at the edge, or wrap.

name: format_cells
title: Format cells
